subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) QWD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ee9ff2d6446a6e06d51dadd3c03c62a325089be05d67521757b7b146b2fbba8.png] 

Option 2) EKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63aaefa545db27d7bc2388ed126c593424eae30b50b75f4bf0aa8a355f6f6c71.png] 

Option 3) RXE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d751e8ecdf7d0862180f5095e900580eff15c0a8adcd5522b673a618a2cc3d2.png] 

Option 4) TZD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b90d732fb0d9eb0f00957d770400bd346268ff413de4b95687642753d98f890.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'TZD' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
